runtime_issues.description: Unused variable 'prev_blocks' in step_ai method. The comparison 'if self.blocks_placed > prev_blocks:' will always evaluate to False because prev_blocks is set to self.blocks_placed immediately before. This causes the positive reward for block placement to never be awarded during AI training.

recommendations.description: Fix the reward calculation logic in game.py step_ai method around line 391. The variable prev_blocks should be captured before the update loop to properly detect when a block is placed.
